decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm’s safety-footwear capabilities, this range would likely be kept unless sales have clearly fallen below aspiration levels, and the missing web evidence alone is too weak to justify withdrawal.

Because this is a more specialised occupational-shoe niche, a German manufacturer facing uncertain results would be somewhat more likely to reallocate resources if its performance stayed below aspirations and no clear traction emerged.
A general safety-shoe series fits the firm’s core business most directly, so under behavioral decision-making it would usually be given more time and retained absent strong signs of underperformance.
